bugs.expected: Menu closes and focus returns to the Snap toggle (task 241 C-MENU-CHOOSE-241 (a), C-MENU-REG-241; GM11/GM18 shape; L47 'never BODY').
bugs.actual: Menu closes, the choice is applied, but document.activeElement is BODY in all 3 cases at both viewports. focusin/focusout log: out:arrangement-snap-toggle -> in:menu item -> out:menu item (no focus back). Pre-existing: identical at HEAD 04c2a5b (scratch dev server :5174) for Escape and division choice, so not introduced by A; the new width items inherit it. Cause measured (out/focus-work-cause.json): at pointerdown/mousedown activeElement = Snap toggle; the browser's default mousedown blurs it; at contextmenu activeElement = BODY, so handleGridMenuRequest (StudioWorkspace.tsx l.1625-1626) stores BODY and closeGridMenu skips the restore (l.1615). Fix direction: capture the return target at pointerdown/mousedown capture. jsdom GM11/GM18 fire contextMenu without a mousedown blur.
